bootstrap_langgraph_runtime: bootstrap LangGraph runtime singletons including stream bridge, checkpointer, store, and run manager on FastAPI app state
get_stream_bridge: get the global StreamBridge singleton from FastAPI request state or raise 503 if unavailable
get_run_manager: get the global RunManager singleton from FastAPI request state or raise 503 if unavailable
get_checkpointer: get the global checkpointer singleton from FastAPI request state or raise 503 if unavailable
get_store: get the optional global store singleton from FastAPI request state returning None if not configured
